title: Evidence record
description: One observed fact about one subject at one point or period in time. Draft, proposed: see notes/dev/rfc/0001-evidence-metrics-lenses.md.

metric.description: Namespaced metric key, for example github.repo.release.downloads.

value.description: The observed value. Objects are for small structured values such as a referrer and its counts.

unit.description: Unit of a numeric value, for example count, hours, percent.

collector.description: Collector plugin ID, for example github/releases.

endpoint.description: The API endpoint or URL the value came from.

access.description: What was needed to see this value.

inputs.description: For derived records: the metric keys they were computed from.

attestation.description: Reference to an artifact attestation covering the file this record was published in.

id.description: Login for accounts, owner/name for repos, as resolved from the API (never user-typed).

nodeId.description: GitHub's stable node ID, so renames don't orphan data.
